sources.entry: OpenRocket - OpenRocket is a cross-platform utility tool to model and simulate model rockets and their flight characteristics.

summary.one_liner: OpenRocket is a free, cross-platform (Java-based) model rocket simulator for designing rockets and simulating their flight before building them.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes OpenRocket as a model rocket design and flight simulator. Users build rockets from a library of built-in components, including scale models, decals, pods, staging, clustering and unusual fin shapes. It offers six-degree-of-freedom flight simulation, automatic design optimization, and real-time display of altitude, velocity and acceleration. Simulation results can be plotted and analyzed, and designs can be visualized in 3D. Components can be exported to OBJ (for 3D printing) or SVG (for laser cutting), and designs can be exported to RockSim and RASAero II formats. The README states the app does not collect telemetry or upload designs, and network access can be disabled in preferences.
use_cases: design model rockets before building them
simulate rocket flight altitude and velocity
plot and analyze rocket simulation results
optimize fin and body design for stability
export rocket parts for 3D printing or laser cutting
convert designs between RockSim and RASAero formats
how_to_run: Download an installer from the OpenRocket releases page (the README links to installers without giving commands)
notable: Exports component geometry to OBJ for 3D printing and SVG for laser cutting
Supports staging, clustering, pods and unusual fin shapes
Ecosystem of related projects including Python integration (orhelper), FreeCAD workbench and motor/parts database
caveats: README does not list platform-specific requirements beyond calling it cross-platform and Java-based
Some network features (update checks, motor-database updates) require internet access unless disabled
